question: How many times was a Twitter/X post cited as a reference on the english Wikipedia pages for each day of August in the last June 2023 versions of the pages?

history.name: user

history.name: Orchestrator
history.content: Goal: Count Twitter/X post citations used as references on the English Wikipedia pages for August 1–31, using each page’s last June 2023 revision. Ignore external links not in references, and ignore X.com (rebrand after June 2023).

history.content: I will use the MediaWiki API. history.name: Orchestrator
history.content: Good. To scale, FileSurfer, check the local June 2023 dump for all August day pages and count reference citations pointing to twitter.com. Also detect {{cite tweet}}. Return per-day counts and a total.

This formatting error (FM-4.4) caused the orchestrator’s JSON parser to fail, leading to a lossy regex fallback that omitted the August_22=1 entry and resulted in the wrong final count (reported 2 instead of the correct 3).
